en.title: Configuring Event Payment Gateways (QRIS & VA)
en.excerpt: How tournament organizers activate automated digital payments via Virtual Accounts and QRIS, and manage manual bank transfer options.
en.content:
Payment Architecture

Archeris supports both automated instant payments and traditional manual bank transfers. Automated payments automatically update participant payment statuses to Paid the instant funds are received, eliminating manual transfer verification.

Automated Digital Gateways

Organizers with active Elite subscription tiers can enable instant digital checkout options:

  • Bank Virtual Accounts (VA): Dynamic VA numbers generated per invoice for Bank BNI, Mandiri, BRI, Permata, and BCA.
  • QRIS & E-Wallets: Instant QR code scanning compatible with GoPay, OVO, Dana, ShopeePay, and all national mobile banking apps.

Manual Bank Transfer Settings

Under Organizer Dashboard > Settings > Payment Methods, organizers can configure manual bank accounts (Bank Name, Account Number, Account Holder Name). Archers upload payment slips, which the organizer manually verifies.

Invoice Expiration Timers

By default, registration invoices expire after 24 hours (or a custom duration set by the organizer). If payment is not completed within this window, the reserved category slot is automatically released back to the public pool.
